name: bnma
description: Bayesian network meta-analysis (BATMAN augmentation + JAGS + forest plots) for the obesity/diabetes landscape team, generalized across endpoints (weight loss, HbA1c, physical function, etc.) -- forced study-selection confirmation, naming/route pooling QA gate, a standalone pooled-placebo model for absolute-effect plots on any model_type, and an opt-in scratch mode for prototyping runs without touching the shared drive.
